history.summary: Mass-market 99yr leasehold 4BR in Bukit Panjang at a sub-$1.4k PSF entry that is genuinely affordable for a family-size unit. But D23 is a low-appreciation OCR fringe with no near-term catalyst, served only by an LRT feeder, so upside is capped.
history.rating_rationale: $1.75M / $1401 PSF for a 1249 sqft 4BR is reasonable value and sits inside the deep $1.8M-and-below family band, supporting decent exit liquidity for HDB upgraders. However D23 Bukit Panjang appreciates at the OCR ~3.7%/yr baseline with no MRT (LRT feeder only) and no government-zone catalyst; the 2014 build is mid-aged. Score 573 / Elo 1222 is mid-pack. A hold-and-rent play, not a growth play.
red_flags: No URA appreciation/txn data supplied — rate inferred from district baseline
Only LRT (Segar BP11) connectivity; D23 is an OCR fringe with weak appreciation history
12yr-old leasehold; depreciation accelerates as lease ages toward the 60yr mark
catalysts: Affordable 4BR entry well below $1.8M attracts a broad HDB-upgrader buyer pool
Bukit Panjang Integrated Transport Hub / Hillion amenities support rental tenancy
